levels.note: Street level around the station; Malmö Arena gives its address as "Hyllie Stationstorg at Malmö Hyllie Station". No source gives a signposted level name.
Platform level: two island platforms serving four tracks in an open cut about 7 m deep (Wikipedia). OSM tags the lifts -1;0. No signposted name found.

open: Track numbering: OSM numbers the platform faces 1–4; Trafikverket's register lists them as tracks 71/72N (BIS 2090) and 73N/74 (BIS 2091), plus a separate track-75 platform (BIS 2597) about 0.9 km south-west, outside the station. Which public number (1–4) matches which register track is not stated in any source read. (Trafikverket, Järnvägsnätsbeskrivning Bilaga 2A tab 4 rows 333–335 and BanInfo BIS 2090/2091/2597 (as compiled in /home/claude/work/out/trafikverket_platforms_SE.csv), read 2026-10-30; OSM (osmfacts 740001586), read 2026-10-30)
No owner pages: Hyllie is not a Jernhusen station; Skånetrafiken's terminal map for Hyllie was not found (file names tried: 80120_hyllie, 80120/80044/80045_malmo-hyllie).
All stairs, lifts and escalators rest on OSM only; no plan or owner text confirms them.
Signposted level names and the platform depth (~7 m per Wikipedia, not measured by the owner).

Shops around the station (Pressbyrån, McDonald's, Subway, Sultan kebab, Kung Fu Dumplings, Brödernas, Swedbank) are outside the station structure per OSM; their own websites could not be read for hours, so only OSM hours exist and they are not repeated here.
Ticket machines and a ticket office: no source read lists them for Hyllie.
